mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which spills over into the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates easier monetary conditions, which stimulates borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by 1% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE) and increasing employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE is low and PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which leads to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by 1% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with high industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE is low and INDPRO is high but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases by 1% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 60 trading days.
